expected_diagnosis: Volume remounted read-only after I/O errors.
recommended_next_checks: Check dmesg, SMART/provider disk health, backup status.
resolution_guidance: Stop writes and escalate storage integrity; controlled repair offline.
verification: Volume mounted normally after verified repair, data checked.
escalate_when: Always escalate suspected physical/storage I/O errors.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
